sentences.text: These Writ Petitions are filed under Articles 226 and 227 of the Constitution of India praying to quash the show cause notice dated 7.6.12, 31.1.12, & 7.6.12 issued by R5 in favour of the petitioners at Annex-B1 to B3 & also final notice dated 08.06.12 in favour of the 4th petitioner at Annex-C.
These petitions coming on for orders this day, the Court made the following:-

PC: 
These writ petition challenges the show cause notices issued to the petitioners and also final notice dated 08.06.12 issued under the regulations framed under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

2. Learned HCGP at the outset invites my attention to Section 31 of the Act and submits that an appeal under sub-section(8) of Section 31 of the Act is provided against the final notice dated 08.06.12 (Annexure-C) impugned in the present writ petitions.
3. Having confronted with this, learned counsel for the petitioners prays for withdrawal of these writ petitions with liberty to the petitioners to file appeal before the competent authority.
4. The petitions are disposed of as withdrawn with liberty as prayed .
All contentions of the parties are kept open.

Sd/-
